name: Coachella Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on issues that matter to young people. You look at what youth need in school, fun and culture, and help link them to city resources.
who_can_apply: You must live in Coachella and be in high school. You can only serve on one city commission at a time.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: One year, August to June. Ten seats.
deadline_text: No dates for the 2026-27 term are posted as of Nov 2, 2026. The newest notice on the page is for one open seat, dated Nov 4, 2025.
how_to_apply: Fill out the commission form on the city page, in English or Spanish. The City Council picks the members. Call the City Clerk at 760-398-3502 to ask if a seat is open.
notes: As of Nov 2, 2026, the member list on the page still shows terms ending in June 2026, so call first. Three unexcused absences in a row can cost you your seat.
